title: Romantic Bali with Sidemen and Seminyak
alt: Rice terraces in the Sidemen valley, east Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Sidemen
stops.subtitle: Sidemen to east Bali
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Valley villa in the rice terraces above Sidemen

activities.name: East Bali sightseeing tour
activities.description: The water palace at Tirta Gangga, the split gate at Lempuyang and the Bukit Cinta viewpoint, a quiet side of the island few visitors see.

activities.name: ATV ride with the Bali swing
activities.description: A quad bike route through rice fields and a cave tunnel, then a turn on the jungle swing with the valley below your feet.

program.name: Sidemen
program.description: Three nights in a valley villa above the Sidemen rice terraces, with east Bali temples, a quad bike route and the jungle swing.

stops.name: Seminyak
stops.subtitle: Seminyak to Nusa Penida and Uluwatu
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Private pool villa a short ride from Seminyak beach

activities.name: Sidemen terraces, Kanto Lampo and Goa Gajah
activities.description: The terraces on the way out of the valley, the wide fan of Kanto Lampo waterfall and the carved doorway at Goa Gajah cave temple.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast
activities.description: Speedboat across for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong and Broken Bay, the three viewpoints that make the early start worth it.

activities.name: Snorkelling off Nusa Penida
activities.description: Mask and fins in the clear water on the way back, with coral heads and reef fish close enough to the shore for beginners.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: An hour of traditional Balinese massage for both of you, warm oil and long pressure strokes, booked privately near the villa.

activities.name: Melasti beach and Uluwatu with Kecak
activities.description: The white sand at Melasti beach, then the cliff top temple at Uluwatu for sunset and the Kecak fire dance in the amphitheatre.

program.name: Seminyak
program.description: Three nights in a private pool villa with a candlelight dinner on arrival, a Nusa Penida day, a couples massage and the Kecak dance.

day_titles.3: Quad bikes and the Bali swing

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your villa
Check in above the Sidemen rice terraces
Rest of the day free on the valley terrace
Optional: a walk through the rice fields before dinner
2: Breakfast, then a full day in east Bali
The water palace and pools at Tirta Gangga
The split gate at Lempuyang temple
The Bukit Cinta viewpoint on the way back
3: Breakfast, then a quad bike route through the fields
A cave tunnel and a river crossing on the way
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
4: Breakfast and check out, then on towards the coast
The Sidemen rice terraces and Kanto Lampo waterfall
Goa Gajah, the carved elephant cave temple
Candlelight dinner for two at your Seminyak villa
5: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong and Broken Bay
Snorkelling in the clear water before the boat back
6: Breakfast, then an hour of Balinese massage for two
Melasti beach, white sand below the cliffs
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
Kecak fire dance in the amphitheatre afterwards
7: Breakfast at the villa and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Sidemen is the Bali people picture before they arrive. Three nights there, three in Seminyak, and you have seen both islands.
expert.tip: Sidemen is an hour and a half from the airport and worth every minute. Carry light walking shoes for the terraces, and let us set the candlelight dinner for your first Seminyak evening.

summary: Seven days for two with three nights in a valley villa above the Sidemen rice terraces and three in a private pool villa near Seminyak, taking in east Bali temples, a quad bike route, waterfalls, Nusa Penida and the Kecak dance at Uluwatu.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; east Bali tour; ATV ride with the Bali swing; Sidemen terraces with Kanto Lampo and Goa Gajah; candlelight dinner; Nusa Penida west coast tour with snorkelling; Balinese massage for two; Melasti beach and Uluwatu with the Kecak dance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
